item.title: ShipStation-Integrated Labor Tracking System
item.description:
Overview

A system for warehouses, e-commerce fulfillment centers, and production lines to track worker productivity and time efficiency in real time.

Key Features

  • Worker time tracking — log in/out per task or shipment
  • ShipStation integration — syncs order and shipment data automatically
  • Productivity reports — per worker, per shift, per department
  • Performance dashboards — visual KPIs for managers

item.title: Database of Licenses System
item.description:
Overview

A two-module system that scrapes license data (automotive, contractor) from government sources daily, tracks new licenses, and monitors status changes of existing ones.

Modules

  1. Scraper — daily automated collection from public license databases
  2. Dashboard — searchable web interface with license status, history, and alerts
